name: Super Tool Co. Ltd.
summary: Super Tool Co. Ltd. manufactures hand tools and tools for industrial equipment and sells them in Japan and internationally, including ratchet, adjustable, pipe and socket wrenches, clamps and pliers, tube cutters, pullers, jig blocks, precision vices and carbide burs. It also designs and sells solar energy generating devices and installs and maintains them. Dating from 1918, it has its headquarters in Sakai, Japan.
